prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
**Robbins Construction** looks like a strong first call for a larger remodel: its Houzz profile lists kitchen and bathroom remodeling, additions, and general contracting, with **5.0 stars from 21 reviews**. The profile lists **(417) 782-8111** and **5777 Gateway Drive, Joplin**. [Houzz profile](https://www.houzz.com/professionals/general-contractors/robbins-construction-pfvwus-pf~1384931546)

For a smaller repair or renovation, **The House Dr., LLC** is another local option; available reviews mention home renovations and bathroom work, and praise communication and reliability. [Reviews and details](https://www.bestprosintown.com/mo/joplin/the-house-dr-llc-/)

These are promising leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, get at least two written estimates, ask for recent references and proof of insurance, and confirm who will handle permits and subcontractors.
